security_invariants: The real journey credential appears only in the Catalyst client URL fragment, is exchanged once through POST, and never reaches Zoho Forms.
The Forms URL contains only an independent 32-byte prefill handle; it contains no CRM ID, journey ID, PII, or configuration value.
Only keyed digests of journey credentials and prefill handles are persisted. Raw bearer values are never logged or stored.
Issue, prefill, and submission use different route secrets; access and exchange expose only the narrow browser exchange boundary.
The assisted submission contains no bearer, CRM record, or journey identifier and resolves its binding exclusively from prefillId and immutable revision.
A tokenless public acknowledgment performs no assisted Data Store or CRM operation; the existing native public upsert remains the public writer.

rollback.first: unbind the CRM assisted launcher and both Zoho Forms server-side callers
rollback.then: disable the five exact Development routes or the Development API Gateway
